verses.text: A Psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom. O LORD, how my foes have increased! How many rise up against me!

xrefs.text: Show the wonders of Your loving devotion, You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their foes.
Instead, I advise that all Israel from Dan to Beersheba— a multitude like the sand on the seashore— be gathered to you, and that you yourself lead them into battle.
Then Absalom and all the men of Israel came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel was with him.
Some time later, Absalom provided for himself a chariot with horses and fifty men to run ahead of him.
All the people answered, “His blood be on us and on our children!

verses.text: Many say of me, “God will not deliver him.” Selah

xrefs.text: saying, “God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for there is no one to rescue him.”
My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”
Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
All who see me mock me; they sneer and shake their heads:
Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah

verses.text: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.

xrefs.text: Then my head will be held high above my enemies around me. At His tabernacle I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.
The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
After these events, the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision: “Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.”
You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.
No longer will the sun be your light by day, nor the brightness of the moon shine on your night; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your splendor.

verses.text: To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah

xrefs.text: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.
Even before they call, I will answer, and while they are still speaking, I will hear.
This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain and to the place where You dwell.

verses.text: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.

xrefs.text: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you rest, your sleep will be sweet.
And I will give peace to the land, and you will lie down with nothing to fear. I will rid the land of dangerous animals, and no sword will pass through your land.
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
You will be secure, because there is hope, and you will look around and lie down in safety.

verses.text: I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side.

xrefs.text: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
Of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?
All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
When the servant of the man of God got up and went out early in the morning, behold, an army with horses and chariots had surrounded the city. So he asked Elisha, “Oh, my master, what are we to do?”

verses.text: Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.

xrefs.text: O God, shatter their teeth in their mouths; O LORD, tear out the fangs of the lions.
I shattered the fangs of the unjust and snatched the prey from his teeth.
They open their mouths against me and strike my cheeks with contempt; they join together against me.
O LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, rouse Yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah
Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.

verses.text: Salvation belongs to the LORD; may Your blessing be on Your people. Selah

xrefs.text: I, yes I, am the LORD, and there is no Savior but Me.
But I, with the voice of thanksgiving, will sacrifice to You. I will fulfill what I have vowed. Salvation is from the LORD!”
The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.
And they cried out in a loud voice: “Salvation to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!
Yet I am the LORD your God ever since the land of Egypt; you know no God but Me, for there is no Savior besides Me.
